title: Installed relay plugins are a cached copy from 21-23 Oct…
what: plugins/core/hooks/merge.py:60: MEDIUM: F12 installed relay plugins are a cached copy from 21-23 Oct; merged skill and agent texts may not reach sessions at all, so neither the merge nor relay sync governs when they go live
why: Found by the design review of the batched paid run (F12), confirmed by the front 24 Oct: ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json points every relay plugin to ~/.claude/plugins/cache/relay/<name>/0.1.0, last copied 21-23 Oct; the cached front SKILL.md has 72 lines, the repo's 147; the cached delegate skill lacks the "has no row for small" text merged 24 Oct. The version stays 0.1.0, so nothing refreshes the copy: merged skills, agents and possibly hooks do not reach sessions, and the paid runs check the repo texts, not what sessions load.
failing_case: 2026-10-23T00:49Z). Its skills/front/SKILL.md has 72 lines and no "paid"; the repo's has 147 lines. The version stays
0.1.0, so nothing tells Claude Code to refresh the copy. If sessions load the cache, the front works from a 3-day-old
front skill, and the paid runs (which evaluate the repo directory, `claude plugin eval "$root"`) checked texts sessions
pass_cases: 1. After a merge that edits plugins/front/skills/front/SKILL.md and the documented refresh step, the copy a new session loads equals the repo's file.
2. `relay doctor` reports a plugin copy that differs from the repo's default branch.
